key_catalyst: Escalating US-Iran Conflict Triggers Fresh Strait of Hormuz Crisis, Driving Risk-Off Sentiment
reasoning: All six open catalysts are dated today and driven by an actively intensifying US-Iran military conflict with no resolution in sight. The US has bombed Iranian cities again, the Strait of Hormuz standoff is worsening, oil is surging 4%+, Treasury yields are at 4.58%, and Asian equities are in freefall (KOSPI -7.3%). QQQ's pre-market decline of -1.11% with no intraday session yet to absorb the shock indicates the market has not had time to digest this escalating geopolitical risk.
